proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics.usageLimit
proposed_widenings.justification: At level 17 the SRD explicitly limits Action Surge to once per turn even though two uses are available per rest. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no perTurnLimit / usageLimit field; only MasteryMechanics has one (MasteryUsageLimit = {kind: 'once_per_turn'}). A parallel optional field on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics would let the tracer emit a use_count fence + turn_start_window for the per-turn cap, keeping it consistent with the mastery subgraph pattern.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

notes: Core mechanic traces cleanly: grant_extra_action (exclude: magic), threshold_tiers cap (base 1, L17→2), short_or_long_rest reset. The existing action_surge.json uses fixed(1) and silently drops the L17 scaling; this encoding uses threshold_tiers to be faithful. The only unrepresentable constraint is the 'only once on a turn' cap at L17 — a new optional usageLimit field on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics (mirroring MasteryUsageLimit) would close this gap. All atoms used are in v4.
